rawMessage: DL145 Gen11 uses AMD EPYC 8004 series compact edge processors (single-socket only). Base chassis P71964-B21 supports 1P configurations with DDR5-4800 memory.
ruleUpdate: DL145 Gen11 is single-socket AMD EPYC 8004 only. No dual-socket configurations supported.

rawMessage: DL145 Gen11 uses P71985-B21 (4-bay EDSFF E3.S drive cage) as the primary storage carrier. Compatible with E3.S NVMe SSDs like P77271-B21.
ruleUpdate: DL145 Gen11 uses EDSFF E3.S form factor drives only. Standard SFF/LFF drives are incompatible.

rawMessage: DL145 Gen11 compact 1U edge chassis supports 900W-1000W PSUs. P54290-B21 (HPE 1000W Flex Slot Titanium Hot Plug Power Supply) is the recommended PSU for edge deployments.
ruleUpdate: DL145 Gen11 supports maximum 1000W PSUs. 1600W/2400W PSUs are physically incompatible.

rawMessage: DL145 Gen11 supports extended ambient temperature range of -5°C to 45°C for edge/harsh-environment deployments. P73021-B21 (Extended Ambient Temperature Configuration Tracking) tracks this capability.
ruleUpdate: DL145 Gen11 edge deployments use P73021-B21 for extended -5C to 45C ambient temperature tracking.
